# employment interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:employmentInterval`](gmeow-employmentInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/employmentInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/employment`](../../slices/employment.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The time interval over which the employment holds. A relator carries its period this way (matching [`gmeow:participationInterval`](gmeow-participationInterval.md), [`gmeow:membershipInterval`](gmeow-membershipInterval.md)) rather than via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md), which is reserved for [gufo:Situation-based](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation-based) time-scoped relations. Open-ended (no end instant) when the employment is current.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Employment`](../classes/gmeow-Employment.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)
